objective: GAN plus recipe.reconstruction_weight times native Gaussian negative ELBO plus recipe.prior_reg times native SBNP on the unique union of generator-side sampled prior/posterior rows. Negative ELBO observes150bagstatistics, sigma.03, both posterior draws, full normalization constant and native hard jointKL log512. No claim of a negative-binomial count likelihood. Encoder and decoder jointly owned by native optimizer; protect existing GAN and reconstruction terms through native constraint_geometry_backward.
